## INFECTIONS IN BONE OR JOINT PROSTHESES
## Empirical therapy before a pathogen is identified is not recommended unless
## patient is clinically unstable.
Some infections may require one or two stage reimplantation. long-term
suppressive antimicrobial therapy or joint removal without replacement may be
options depending on patient's condition. Consult Infectious Diseases
(inpatient) for more information.
## Infectious Disease and Orthopedics consultations are essential.
If patient has sepsis or is otherwise unstable, empiric treatment before culture
results are obtained may be justified.
## Inpatient

Cefepime 2g IV q12h [R] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg q12h [R]
## _______________________________________________________________________________
## Outpatient

Refer to the Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS
